_about: Leagues, pickup games and recurring groups in greater Burlington (Burlington, South Burlington, Winooski, Essex, Essex Junction, Colchester, Williston, Shelburne and nearby). Read by clubs.html; checked by scripts/build_groups.py, which also writes data/clubs.json (never edit that one by hand). Run, walking and road-cycling clubs live in data/run-clubs.json instead, and must not be repeated here.

VERIFIED means: every fact in an entry was read on the group's OWN page (its website, the host venue's or town's own schedule or registration page, its Meetup group or event page, its Instagram or Facebook page when readable) on checked.date. checked.source is that page's URL and checked.note quotes what it says. Aggregators (Seven Days listings, Yelp, AllEvents, Eventbrite search, old news stories) are leads only. Nothing is guessed: a field the page does not support is left empty or false.

A meet is a standing WEEKLY slot (same weekday each week). time is 24-hour HH:MM, or null with a note when the page gives the night but not the hour. A group whose day changes, or that meets monthly, gets meets: [] and a schedule_note saying when and where to look. Seasonal slots carry months, or from/until dates (both days included), on the meet or the group, so the page does not show an off-season league; skip lists dates with no meet.

free is true only when the page says free (or donation), and cost must then say so; beginner is true only when the page says beginners, all levels, or learn-to-play are welcome. These drive the page's Free and Beginner friendly filters.

To add a group: read its own page, add an entry (id, name, kind, category, what, meets, schedule_note, season, where, town, cost, free, level, beginner, signup{how, url}, newcomers, url, links{site, instagram, facebook, meetup, discord, calendar}, checked{date, source, note, also[]}), then run python3 scripts/build_groups.py. It must print OK. Re-read any group it warns is stale (over 120 days) or whose season ended.

kind is one of: league, pickup, games, trivia, books, language, music, dance, making, outdoors, social, other. Stephen's own Meetup group stays in, featured (his own events are never missed). Readers can also send groups in through the page's form; those wait for Stephen in groups-mod.html (db/groups-submit.sql) and are not in this file.
